interest: This document is a Department of State List of Papers / cross-reference sheet documenting the receipt and routing of John Franklin Carter's transmittal of Curtis B. Munson's famous late-1941 report on Japanese populations along the Pacific Coast. It is historically significant because it confirms that Munson's pre-Pearl Harbor intelligence assessment included supplementary investigations into Japanese populations in British Columbia, Canada, and Lower California, Mexico, reflecting broad hemispheric security concerns. The cross-reference to 894.20211/4921 provides a vital archival link for researchers tracking the dissemination of the Munson Report within the U.S. government just weeks before the outbreak of the Pacific War.
overview: This file consists of a single-page Department of State 'List of Papers' docket sheet (Form DS-46) under decimal file 894.20242, which covers Japanese military affairs, espionage, intelligence gathering, and propaganda in Canada. The sheet records a single entry (sub-number 7) for a memorandum dated November 7, 1941, from presidential intelligence coordinator John Franklin Carter, transmitting Curtis B. Munson's report 'Japanese on the West Coast' along with supplementary reports covering Lower California and British Columbia, cross-referenced to decimal file 894.20211/4921.
